question: Since 1 Nov 2026, every time an operator note reports gas at a well, did we get someone out to that well in time under our operating procedures? List every report and whether the response met the deadline.

response.answer: 96 breached or overdue rule(s), including possible breaches where required evidence is absent from the loaded data. Open regulator events carry USD 50,000 in recorded fines. Pending actions and met duties are listed separately. Spill coverage: 136 candidates; 136 resolved containment timings; 0 missing reports; 0 reports with unparsed timing; 0 unknown volumes. All candidate spill volumes and containment timings are resolved.
